subject: Superintendent Composite Evaluation
overview: The Medford School Committee Evaluation Subcommittee met to synthesize individual members' reviews into a composite evaluation for Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent. The subcommittee approved ratings and narrative comments across all evaluation categories to forward to the full School Committee.

items.title: Superintendent Composite Evaluation Review
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the draft composite evaluation synthesized from individual members' reviews of the superintendent.

items.title: Step 1: Progress Toward Goals
items.summary: Approved a recommendation to rate the superintendent's performance as met across all professional practice, student learning, and district improvement goals.

items.title: Step 2: Performance Standards Ratings
items.summary: Approved a recommended performance standard rating of proficient across all four evaluated areas.

items.title: Step 3: Overall Summative Performance Ranking
items.summary: Agreed on recommending an overall summative performance rating of proficient.

items.title: Step 4: Evaluator Comments
items.summary: Approved including the compiled draft narrative feedback and focus indicator comments in the final composite report as written.

items.title: Final Recommendation to Full Committee
items.summary: Voted to submit the finalized composite superintendent evaluation report for full School Committee approval.
